_comment: Health check configuration for a content pipeline. These checks catch problems before they embarrass you — leaked template variables, broken OG images, dead links, thin content. Run on a schedule (2x/day recommended) and on every deploy.

checks.name: template-variable-leak
checks.description: Unrendered template literals like ${firstName} or [object Object] visible on the live page
checks.notes: Common when newsletter content leaks into blog posts. Check against rendered text, not raw HTML, to avoid false positives on code examples.

checks.name: broken-og-image
checks.description: OG image URL returns non-200 status
checks.notes: Google and social platforms cache OG images aggressively. A broken OG image persists for days even after you fix it. Check every page's og:image URL returns 200 with content-type image/*.

checks.name: injected-ad-link
checks.description: Tracking links or sponsor ad links that leaked from newsletter content into blog posts
checks.notes: If you repurpose newsletter content to blog posts, email tracking parameters and sponsor links can survive the conversion.

checks.name: thin-content
checks.description: Published page with less than 300 words of visible text
checks.notes: Thin pages dilute your site's quality signal. Either add depth or noindex them.

checks.name: dead-page
checks.notes: Run against every URL in your sitemap. Dead pages in the sitemap cause GSC validation failures and waste crawl budget.

checks.name: empty-paragraph
checks.description:
Empty

or double-wrapped

tags in rendered HTML
checks.notes: Usually indicates a markdown rendering bug or content generation error.

checks.name: missing-schema
checks.description: Blog post without Article or NewsArticle structured data
checks.notes: Schema markup is the foundation of rich results. Every post should have at minimum Article + author Person entity.

checks.name: stale-news-sitemap
checks.description: News sitemap contains entries older than 48 hours
checks.notes: Google ignores news sitemap entries older than 48h. Stale entries signal a broken pipeline.

schedule.recommended: Every 12 hours via GitHub Actions or cron

implementation.approach: Fetch each URL from your sitemap, parse the HTML, run each check against the rendered content. Use a real HTTP client with a browser-like User-Agent to avoid bot-challenge false positives.
implementation.concurrency: 10 concurrent fetches max (don't hammer your own site)
implementation.exitCode: Non-zero if any FAIL-level issue found (CI-friendly)
